title: Billing Standard: Amount of the In-Place Home Resale Initial Inspection Charge
content:
**Clause.** The standard inspection charge for an In-Place Home Resale file is the package's inspection fee, charged in full for the initial inspection and rounded half up to the cent. On a package whose inspection fee is 0.00 no inspection charge is posted at all. The inspection date of the charge is the record date of the file's initial inspection, and the charge carries that date.

**Quantities.**

- *Package's inspection fee* — the initial inspection fee of the package on the file, as the package's inspection program schedule gives it.
- *Inspection date* — the record date of the initial inspection recorded on the file.
- *Rounding* — half up to the cent, once, on the final figure of the charge.

| Package's inspection fee | Charge posted for the initial inspection |
|---|---|
| above 0.00 | the inspection fee, in full, rounded half up to the cent |
| 0.00 | none |

## Worked figures (hypothetical files)

- A file on a package whose inspection fee is 125.00, initial inspection recorded on 12 March: the charge is 125.00, dated 12 March.
- A file on a package whose inspection fee is 0.00, initial inspection recorded on 12 March: no inspection charge is posted.
